text:
Jamal (Hiring Ops): heads-up — need an approval path for an offer exception. Candidate: Priya K, IC3 SWE. Comp band top is 180000 base, manager requesting 195000 base + 15% equity. Offer expires in 5 days. Can we route to Finance + VP Eng?
Maria (People Ops): @Jamal can you paste the comp calc and a 1-2 line justification? Also confirm location — bands differ by region.
Jamal (Hiring Ops): Location: SF. Comp calc: base=195000, equity=15%, signing ~20k. Justification: counteroffer risk from competitor, candidate owned critical infra project. Hiring manager requests stretch to secure hire.
Alex (Eng Manager): Strong +1. Priya drove our cache migration — critical. Preferred start date Feb 1 (4 week notice). If approvals are quick we can keep Feb 1.
Samir (Recruiter): Candidate confirmed 4-week notice, Feb 1 works. I can hold verbal for 5 days but need formal in-hand by end of week. Any approvals still pending?
Maria (People Ops): Quick FYI on policy: >10% over band needs People Ops + Finance + VP Eng signoff. >15% escalates to CEO. This request is ~8.3% over top-of-band (195k v 180k) so People Ops + Finance + VP Eng should cover it. I'll kick off routing once you drop the justification doc and comp csv. Link to policy: https://redwood.example.com/comp-policy
people-ops-bot: Approval request created: APPR-1772501234. Current approvers: Maria (People Ops), finance-approvals, Alex (Eng Manager). Link: https://redwood.example.com/approvals/1772501234
Jamal (Hiring Ops): Added justification doc: https://drive.redwood.example.com/priya-justif.pdf and comp calc CSV attached to the approval request. @Maria please route to finance when you have a second.
Maria (People Ops): Routing now to finance. Tagging @finance-approvals and @vp-eng. Note: finance may ask for comp modeling (1-year cost + ramp). Expect 24-48h for response.
Alex (Eng Manager): If finance asks about equity format — prefer RSU grant at 15% v 4-year vesting. Happy to discuss. :thumbsup:
Samir (Recruiter): Great — I'll let candidate know we're routing and expect final in 48h. If we need to accelerate, can we temporarily offer 190k and adjust post-approval?
Maria (People Ops): Please avoid provisional offers — that creates mismatch risk. Let's wait for signoff. If timeline becomes critical we can escalate to VP Eng for an expedited review.
Jamal (Hiring Ops): Understood — holding verbal but not sending numbers. Thanks all, will ping if finance asks for more detail.
